judged_text: `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` is a silent no-op when the preceding ternary set `destinationCalendar` to null (no eventType.destinationCalendar and no organizerUser.destinationCalendar), so the collected teamDestinationCalendars are discarded For a COLLECTIVE event where the organizer has no default calendar but team members do, the members' destination calendars are collected in teamDestinationCalendars and then silently dropped — no calendar event is created for anyone, with no error, no log, and no failed EventResult; the exact multi-host scenario this PR adds silently does nothing

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set via a ternary to either `[eventType.destinationCalendar]`, `[organizerUser.destinationCalendar]`, or `null` (when both are missing). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional-chained `push` is a silent no-op, so any collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are dropped. This is directly verifiable from the diff and would prevent those team member destination calendars from being used downstream.
